distribution: Drop-in zip per server OS (compiled SMX, ProjectSky websocket and json extensions, config)

statusDefinitions.live-supported: Implemented in the SourceMod plugin and proven through Takaro with a real Steam client on a secure TF2 dedicated server.
statusDefinitions.schema-fallback: Returns a Takaro-valid fallback or structured partial response because the SourceMod/TF2 server surface is configuration-dependent.
statusDefinitions.unsupported: Returns an explicit structured unsupported response, or is intentionally not emitted by the TF2 server-side connector.

knownGaps: SourceMod 1.13 and MetaMod:Source 1.12 are required; SourceMod 1.12 crashes current TF2 builds
getPlayerInventory reports equipped weapons (item definition index + catalog name); it does not expose the Steam backpack or cosmetics
listItems reports a generated TF2 weapon catalog (tsuza/tf2-item-schema); codes are item definition indexes
listEntities reports a fixed catalog: Engineer buildings, the sapper and Halloween bosses
listLocations reads the running map: intel home positions, team spawns and control points
getMapInfo returns a disabled MapInfoDTO and getMapTile a placeholder; TF2 has no map tiles
listBans reports connector bans (persisted in data/takaro_tf2_bans.txt) plus permanent bans in cfg/banned_user.cfg; Takaro cannot lift the latter
shutdown is off by default; server.shutdown is declared only when takaro_tf2_shutdown_enabled is 1
banPlayer and unbanPlayer require real SteamID64 identities; servers started with -insecure report SOURCE_* ids that cannot be banned
entity-killed covers TF2 object_destroyed events (Engineer buildings), not every entity removal
giveItem is unsupported: a TF2 server cannot grant Steam items, so shop item delivery is unavailable
